name: Kid Natsu no Hayate Junmai Ginjo

producer.name: Heiwa Shuzo
producer.about: Heiwa Shuzo is a sake brewery in Mizonokuchi, Kainan, Wakayama, founded in 1928. A man from an old sake family married into the Yamamoto family, who had kept a Buddhist temple for generations, and started the brewery, so it is still sometimes called by the temple's trade name, Chogan-ji. The name Heiwa, meaning peace, comes from the second head's wish to brew in a peaceful era after the war.
